init.description:
Adjust peak/valley hours, tier prices, and energy statistics.

Default prices (CNY/kWh):
- Tier 1: Peak 0.568 / Valley 0.288
- Tier 2: Peak 0.618 / Valley 0.338
- Tier 3: Peak 0.868 / Valley 0.588
